insights.one_liner: Amsterdam maker of repairable, sustainable phones and earbuds; an IND sponsor with an English-language senior compliance role open.

culture.text: Mission-driven: wants to change the electronics industry from the inside with modular, repairable devices.
Describes itself as a diverse and inclusive team from all walks of life, built on social and environmental values.
